name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: RECONCILE-support: add the deterministic Reconcile class + ReconcileResult schema (closed_issues/rebased/relanded/skipped/errors) + the injectable gh_pr_state_source/gh_issue_state_source/gh_issue_close_sink/reconcile_rebase_worktree seams. Reads the injected acted_ledger slot; (A) closes a merged-PR's still-open issue, (B) recovers a CONFLICTING loop PR via tier-1 rebase / tier-2 re-land. Advisory (emits only OK, never blocks the tick), trust-gated exactly like INTEGRATE.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already carries the RECONCILE-support section (committed on this branch as the spec-update step); this cycle implements it in src + tests + contract and re-anchors the housekeep doc baseline
